Server-generated sample only. No microphone and no Codex. The server address is the private WSS endpoint already saved on this watch; only its host is reused on the fixed service port. Audio is written to a temporary cache file and deleted when you pause, stop or leave. This screen reports actual network bytes and local playback state; it does not prove the sound was heard.
Ready. Press “Probe server voice” to request the sample.
